title: Background Agents in Slack
description: Cursor now supports launching Background Agents directly from Slack by mentioning @Cursor. Agents can read threads, understand context, and create PRs without leaving the conversation.

title: Aider v0.86.0
description: Added support for all GPT-5 models, Grok-4, gemini-2.5-flash-lite-preview-06-17, and openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2. Aider wrote 88% of the code in this release.

title: Windsurf Editor Changelog - February 2026 Updates
description: Fixed Windows update initialization path that could block updates; Released binaries for Linux ARM64. JetBrains plugin updated to version 2.12.14.
